test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 8

questions.question: A shopkeeper professes to sell his goods at a 35% loss but uses a false balance and gains 10%. The actual weight (correct to one decimal place) he uses for 1 kg is:
A seven-digit number is divisible by 42. If the digits are rearranged except the last two digits of the number, then the number is always divisible by _____.
If 20% of a number is added to 360, then the result is the same number. 80% of the same number is:
Hardik deposited a sum of ₹34,300 at 20% rate of interest per annum, compounded annually. The total amount (in ₹) received by Hardik after 2 years is:3250
A person drove at 76 km/hr for 2.5 hours, then increased his speed by 21 km/hr, and reached the destination in another hour. Find the average speed (in km/hr) of the person for the entire journey.
Amit has borrowed an amount of ₹3,00,000 from a bank to start a business. How much simple interest (in ₹) will he pay at a rate of 5% per annum after 2 years?3716

If 25 people, working for 10 hours a day, can complete 2 units of work in 5 days, then how many days will be required by 10 people to complete 16 units of work, if each person works for 8 hours a day?
The average of first 13 multiples of 11 is:
A cosmetic product is available at a discount of 11% on its marked price. If the shopkeeper charges ₹1,691, what is its marked price?

The list price of an article is ₹1,000 and a discount of 62% is offered on the list price. What additional percentage of discount must be offered on the already discounted price to a customer to bring the net selling price to ₹205.20?
A man receives ₹8,325 per month as salary. He saves 20% of his salary every month. His expenditure (in ₹) per month is:
P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 8 hours. If P alone can fill the same amount of water in 72 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill the same amount of water?
The height of a cylinder, open at the top, is 26 cm and its internal diameter is 9 cm. What is its internal surface area, in cm2 (correct to one decimal place)? (Take π = 22/7)
756 is divided into three parts in such a way that half of the first part, one-fourth of the second part and one-eighth of the third part are equal. What is the value of second part?
In what ratio should sugar costing ₹55/kg be mixed with sugar costing ₹44/kg, so that by selling the mixture at ₹52.8/kg, there is a profit of 10%?

A person has to cover a distance of 24 km in 3 hours. If he covers one-fourth of the distance in one-third of the total time, then what should his speed (in km/hr) be to cover the remaining distance in the remaining time so that the person reaches the destination exactly on time?
If 84 : y :: y : 21, then find the positive value of y.
P and Q together can fill a cistern with water in 2 hours. If P alone can fill the cistern in 4 hours, then in how many hours will Q alone fill the cistern?
A train crosses an electric pole in 15 seconds and a platform 150 metres long in 30 seconds. What is the speed of the train (in km/hr)?

The weight of a solid metallic sphere of radius 8 cm is 16 kg. Find the weight (in kg) of a hollow sphere made of the same metal, whose outer diameter is 20 cm and inner diameter is 4 cm. (Assume that the weight is directly proportional to the volume.)
